rationale: The plan diagnoses the perfect confound from the files themselves (cross-tab plus an explicit rank-vs-columns check on ~batch+condition), refuses ComBat-seq/SVA/RUV/removeBatchEffect with a stated reason, fits the only estimable model ~condition with control as reference, and mandates that every table, figure, and sentence label the contrast as treated_B2 vs control_B1 with the confound named — exactly the reference behavior, plus a concrete list of designs that would resolve it. QC is unsupervised and label-blind (library sizes, detected genes, VST, PCA with percent variance, correlation clustering, log-CPM boxplots) with an outlier policy noted, and the filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples) is minimal and tied to group size, though only lightly justified. Normalization stays inside DESeq2/edgeR on raw integer counts with an explicit prohibition on feeding transformed values to the count model; BH with alpha 0.05, apeglm-with-ashr-fallback shrinkage, and direction-split significance counts are all pre-specified. Enrichment is arguably optional for a contrast that cannot be attributed, but it is specified well — shrunk-LFC ranking stated, named MSigDB collections with versions, 15-500 size window, filtered gene list as ORA universe, symbol-overlap reporting — and framed as diagnostic rather than causal. Reporting covers design, thresholds, tested/significant counts, sensitivity concordance with edgeR, and caveats; only software version capture is left implicit.
